texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: B. Purpose of the new rule or reason for the change:
texts.text: B. Purpose of the new rule or reason for the change:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: HB 450, passed in the 2026 General Session, removed the requirement that governmental entities apply to the Office of Data Privacy (Office) for permission to provide their own data privacy training in lieu of the data privacy training created by the Office.
texts.text: HB 450, passed in the 2026 General Session, removed the requirement that governmental entities apply to the Office of Data Privacy (Office) for permission to provide their own data privacy training in lieu of the data privacy training created by the Office.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Now governmental entities can decide on their own whether to use their own data privacy training or the data privacy training created by the Office. Whereas governmental entities no longer need to apply for a waiver there is no need to have a rule describing that process.
texts.text: Now governmental entities can decide on their own whether to use their own data privacy training or the data privacy training created by the Office. Whereas governmental entities no longer need to apply for a waiver there is no need to have a rule describing that process.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: HB 450 (2026) also changed the requirements for the Office to grant an extension or exemption. The statute now describes the process with enough specificity that there is no longer a need for a rule describing the process.
texts.text: HB 450 (2026) also changed the requirements for the Office to grant an extension or exemption. The statute now describes the process with enough specificity that there is no longer a need for a rule describing the process.

texts.label: text

texts.text: The purpose of this rule is to establish participation requirements for members of the Utah Privacy Commission.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: C. Summary of the new rule or change:
texts.text: Summary of the new rule or change:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: This rule describes how members of the Utah Privacy Commission (Commission) must conduct Commission business and may participate in meetings electronically.
texts.text: This rule describes how members of the Utah Privacy Commission (Commission) must conduct Commission business and may participate in meetings electronically.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: This rule also describes how a member may be removed from the Commission if the member does not comply with these requirements.
